text:
emma: Quick sync  we need final newsletter + webinar invite for next Wed. Focus: launch narrative + benchmark highlights + clear trial CTA. Draft here: https://docs.google.com/launch-webinar-draft. Can we finalize subject lines, segmentation rules, and cadence by EOD?

raj: I'll take segmentation and expected audience sizes. Thinking segments: trial_active, scale_accounts, and dormant_newsletter. Will share SQL filters and counts in a bit.

sofia: Planning to run a three-way subject test. Variants: bold benchmark claim, product-led invite, and softer educational angle. Keep preheaders short.

liam: I prefer A/B/C with unique CTAs on the landing page to measure registration conversion. Also propose two send waves for APAC to avoid 2am open rates. Drafts below: 

```
Variant 1 Subject: Live demo  See Redwood inference in action (30ms median)
Preheader: Real benchmark numbers + early trial credits

Variant 2 Subject: How teams cut inference cost by 3x (live demo)
Preheader: Benchmarks, demo, Q&A

Variant 3 Subject: Join our launch webinar  learn what improves LLM economics
Preheader: Short demo and practical tips
```

maya: Deliverability note: keep main send <= 80% of quota and stagger 15% over next 6 hours if we hit throttling. Recommend sends: test cohort Mon 09:30 PT, main Tue 16:00 UTC, APAC wave Wed 00:30 UTC (small batch). Post-event: recording + 24h follow-up + 72h CTA reminder.

ops-bot: Heads-up: marketing send quota for Tue 16:00 UTC is 18k. Tag send-group 'launch-webinar-2026'.

emma: Good. @raj can you paste the SQL for each segment and projected counts? We need the exact send groups for ops.

raj: Draft segmentation: 
- trial_active: user_last_seen <= 14 AND api_calls_14d >= 5 AND unsubscribed = false
- scale_accounts: account_type IN ('enterprise','scale') AND seats >= 8 AND active = true
- dormant_newsletter: subscribed = true AND last_engagement_days > 90 AND email_open_rate_90d < 0.1
- exclude: suppression_list = true OR bounced = true OR unsubscribed = true

Projected list sizes: trial_active ~ 3,200; scale_accounts ~ 1,100; dormant_newsletter ~ 9,700. Total ~14k (we'll throttle to quota). I'll add exact SQL snippets to the doc.

sofia: Messaging notes: for trial_active keep subject benchmark-forward. For scale_accounts emphasize SLA, dedicated capacity and private options. For dormant_newsletter use curiosity-led subject and a clear, low-friction CTA.

liam: Landing page variants: A—benchmarks first, B—product-first with demo video; use different hero CTAs: 'Register' vs 'See benchmarks'. Track UTM_campaign=launch2026_variantA/B/C.

maya: Drip schedule recommendation: 
- Registrants: confirmation + calendar invite immediately, reminder 24h before, 1h before, and 15m before.
- Non-registrants: 48h reminder with short clip + CTA.
- Post-event: within 24h send recording + survey + personalized trial code for attendees; for no-shows send recording + 'try now' link 24h after and a follow-up 7 days after.

emma: Action items: @sofia publish final subject variants by 3pm PT; @raj paste SQL and confirm counts; @maya schedule test send Mon 09:30 PT and main Tue 16:00 UTC; I'll finalize copy and coordinate dry run.

sofia: Will finalize subjects now. Preference: trial_active gets Variant 1; scale_accounts Variant 2; dormant_newsletter Variant 3.

raj: SQL snippets added to doc; counts confirmed. I've also created audience export labels: launch_trial_0326, launch_scale_0326, launch_dormant_0326.

maya: Scheduling test send and small APAC wave now. Will attach inbox previews and spam-check screenshots to the doc.

ops-bot: Test send scheduled: group 'launch-test' on Mon 09:30 PT. Main send queued for Tue 16:00 UTC (pending final approval).

liam: One more ask: can we include a short benchmark table image (png) for the email? size small so it doesn't trigger spam filters.

emma: Yes, design will provide a compact benchmark graphic. Also keep copy modular so we can swap CTAs per segment.

sofia: Final note: avoid hype terms like 'game changer' in subject lines for enterprise accounts. Keep factual claims source-linked (link to benchmark repo).

emma: Great. I'll review the final doc at 5pm PT and trigger the dry run. Thanks everyone :rocket:
